input.quote: either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 6 (and the misplaced 6(c) at p0044) deals only with notice periods, final fees and assignment of Works in progress; Sections 4 and 8 address ownership and confidentiality but impose no obligation to return or export Company data, and nothing anywhere provides transition assistance or deletion timing. There is therefore no usable exit clause at either the preferred or fallback level, so we insert a single short paragraph in the Termination section carrying the preferred elements (six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable return, certified deletion after return), with 90 days of assistance available as a fallback. We used generic wording for Company data because "Customer Data" is not a defined term in this agreement.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return and certified deletion obligations in the Termination section.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The agreement has no exit provisions, so we add a short clause: on expiry or termination Contractor provides up to six (6) months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our data within thirty (30) days in a machine-readable format, and certifies deletion after that return. Our fallback is 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination, return to Company all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Company in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) after such return, delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.
